data_mono.usage: Ticket IDs, SLA Countdowns, Audit Logs

typography.instructions: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use Cabinet Grotesk for prominent headings. IBM Plex Sans for dense data/body text. Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric SLA counters to emphasize precision.

colors.instructions: Strictly avoid generic purple gradients. Rely on stark contrast (Black/White or Deep Slate/White). Color should be used purely functionally to denote status, priority, and SLA risk.

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation + Main content area. Left-sidebar must be collapsible for high-density focus.
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B (High Density Grid). Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use 'The Technical Look' with exposed grid lines (border-collapse, border-r, border-b) for admin metric panels.
layouts.ticket_detail: Two-column layout (lg:grid-cols-3). Main wide column (col-span-2) for message threads and public/internal tabbed comments. Narrow sidebar (col-span-1) for Ticket Metadata, SLA countdown, Status changes, and Assignee details.
layouts.tables: Full-width, sticky-header tables for ticket lists. Use compact padding (py-2 px-4) for dense data readability. Row hover states must be explicit (hover:bg-muted/50).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look') for dashboards. Avoid heavy shadows. Use 1px sharp borders to separate widgets. Border radius should be minimal, max 6px (rounded-md) to reinforce the B2B tech feel.
visual_enhancers.sla_countdown: Must be visually distinct. Use 'Retro-Futurism' terminal styling for the timer: black/dark slate background, monospace font, glowing text drop-shadow if SLA is breached (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(220,38,38,0.5)]).
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangular (rounded-sm) with high-contrast text. Example: bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400 for Critical.
visual_enhancers.notifications: Real-time dropdown with unread dot. Include a toast notification (using Sonner) for SLA breach alerts or new ticket assignments.

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-[1px] with shadow-sm for interactive cards. Explicit background color change for table rows and list items.
motion.sla_urgency: If SLA is in 'Warning' (< 1hr) or 'Breached', add a slow pulse animation (animate-pulse) to the indicator dot or border.
motion.page_transitions: Keep animations minimal and snappy to respect the serious B2B operational environment.

components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts for SLA trend analysis (line charts) and Agent performance (bar charts). Apply semantic colors (green/yellow/red) directly to chart bars based on threshold values.
components_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table component. Implement explicit data-testid on action buttons (e.g., data-testid='ticket-row-123-escalate-btn').
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, and Textarea. Maintain left-aligned labels.
components_instructions.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs to strictly separate 'Public Reply' and 'Internal Note' in the ticket detail view. The Internal Note area should have a distinct background tint (e.g., bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20) to prevent accidental public posting.
components_instructions.feedback: Star rating modal must be accessible. Use lucide-react 'Star' icons with fill transition on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially SLA timers and badges, pass WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='create-ticket-btn', data-testid='sla-timer-display'.

image_urls.description: Professional profile portrait for Agent Assignee
Abstract tech company logo for sidebar brand header

media_and_icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all system icons. Use the provided avatar URLs for mocking agent/customer profiles in the tables and ticket message threads.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
